records.en: (I will record my memories of everyone in my heart.<CR>I will engrave them there so they never disappear!)

records.jp: 陽桜莉さーん！<CR>今から、インタビューするから答えてくんない？
records.en_original: Hey, Hiori! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Hiori! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en: Hiori-san!<CR>I want to interview you now. Will you answer?

records.jp: インタビュー？<CR>うん、私に答えられることなら
records.en_original: Questions? Sure, as long as I know the answers.
records.en_auxiliary: Questions? Sure, as long as I know the answers.
records.en: An interview?<CR>Sure, if it is something I can answer.

records.jp: えーっと……この世界に来て<CR>一番、印象に残っていることはなんですか！
records.en_original: Let's see... What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en_auxiliary: Let's see... What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en: Let me see... What is the thing that left the strongest impression on you<CR>since coming to this world?

records.jp: もちろん、愛央ちゃんと一緒に遊んだことだよ！
records.en_original: Hanging out with you, of course!
records.en_auxiliary: Hanging out with you, of course!
records.en: Of course, playing with Ao-chan!

records.jp: 二人で、色んな場所に行ったけど<CR>ぜーんぶ、楽しかった！
records.en_original: We went to lots of different places together, but they were all so fun!
records.en_auxiliary: We went to lots of different places together, but they were all so fun!
records.en: We went to all sorts of places together,<CR>and every single one was fun!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんと一緒にいると、胸の中の<CR>モヤモヤしたものが、綺麗になくなっちゃうの
records.en_original: All my problems just disappear when I'm with you.
records.en_auxiliary: All my problems just disappear when I'm with you.
records.en: When I am with Ao-chan, the murky feelings<CR>inside my chest disappear completely.

records.jp: それで、私も、もっともっと頑張ろうっ！って、<CR>前向きな気持ちになれたんだよ
records.en_original: That helped me stay positive and keep moving forward even when things were tough.
records.en_auxiliary: That helped me stay positive and keep moving forward even when things were tough.
records.en: And then I could feel positive and think,<CR>"I will try even harder and harder!"

records.jp: あはは……それはさすがに、褒めすぎ。<CR>え、えっと、じゃあ、次の質問ね！
records.en_original: Ahaha... You're too sweet! U-um, okay, next question...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... You're too sweet! U-um, okay, next question...
records.en: Ahaha... That is praising me too much.<CR>U-um, then, the next question!

records.jp: あ、待って。私からも質問したい！<CR>どうして急にインタビューなんて始めたの？
records.en_original: Hey, wait. I want to ask something too. Why did you feel like doing this interview all of a sudden?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, wait. I want to ask something too. Why did you feel like doing this interview all of a sudden?
records.en: Ah, wait. I want to ask something too!<CR>Why did you suddenly begin an interview?

records.jp: それは、みんなのことを<CR>動画に残しておこうかなと思って
records.en_original: I just wanted to have a recording of everybody.
records.en_auxiliary: I just wanted to have a recording of everybody.
records.en: I thought I would<CR>leave videos of everyone.

records.jp: ……動画に残しても、全部消えちゃうのに？
records.en_original: Even though the videos will disappear?
records.en_auxiliary: Even though the videos will disappear?
records.en: ...Even though everything in the video will disappear?

records.jp: ……そっか。<CR>愛央ちゃんは不安だったんだね
records.en_original: ...Oh. You're scared, huh, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Oh. You're scared, huh, Ao?
records.en: ...I see.<CR>Ao-chan was anxious.

records.jp: この世界が消えてしまったら、<CR>私たちの繋がりも消えてしまうんじゃないかって
records.en_original: It scares you to think that our bond could disappear along with this world, right?
records.en_auxiliary: It scares you to think that our bond could disappear along with this world, right?
records.en: That when this world disappears,<CR>our connection might disappear too.

records.jp: 私もね、同じこと考えてたから、<CR>愛央ちゃんの気持ち少しだけ分かるんだ
records.en_original: I get that. I was thinking the same thing.
records.en_auxiliary: I get that. I was thinking the same thing.
records.en: I was thinking the same thing,<CR>so I understand how Ao-chan feels a little.

records.jp: でも……本当にそうなのかな？<CR>本当にすべて、リセットされちゃうのかな？
records.en_original: But is that really what's going to happen? Is everything really going to be reset?
records.en_auxiliary: But is that really what's going to happen? Is everything really going to be reset?
records.en: But... is that really true?<CR>Will absolutely everything truly be reset?

records.jp: ……どういうこと？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: ...What do you mean?

records.jp: この世界に来た時、私たちは何もかも忘れていた。<CR>……それでも、思い出すことが出来たよね
records.en_original: We didn't remember anything when we first came to this world, but we were able to regain our memories.
records.en_auxiliary: We didn't remember anything when we first came to this world, but we were able to regain our memories.
records.en: When we came to this world, we had forgotten everything.<CR>...Even so, we were able to remember, right?

records.jp: 良いことも悪いことも……全部。<CR>それって、心がそれを求めていたからだと思うの
records.en_original: The good, the bad... All of it. I think the only reason that was possible was because our hearts longed for those memories.
records.en_auxiliary: The good, the bad... All of it. I think the only reason that was possible was because our hearts longed for those memories.
records.en: The good things and the bad things... everything.<CR>I think that was because our hearts sought them.

records.jp: 想いが力になるのなら……強く願えばいい。<CR>絶対に、絶対に、みんなのことは忘れないって。
records.en_original: So maybe all we have to do is wish as hard as we can that we'll never, ever forget each other.
records.en_auxiliary: So maybe all we have to do is wish as hard as we can that we'll never, ever forget each other.
records.en: If feelings become power, then we only have to wish strongly.<CR>That we will absolutely, absolutely never forget everyone.

records.jp: 私は……大好きな人を、忘れたりしないよ。<CR>必ず、愛央ちゃんに会えるって信じてる
records.en_original: I refuse to forget the people I love. I know I'll see you again, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I refuse to forget the people I love. I know I'll see you again, Ao.
records.en: I... will not forget the people I love.<CR>I believe I will definitely meet Ao-chan again.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori-san...

records.jp: あれ……動画、消しちゃうの？
records.en_original: Huh? You're deleting the video?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? You're deleting the video?
records.en: Huh? Are you deleting the video?

records.jp: うん。<CR>陽桜莉さんのおかげで、必要ないって分かったから
records.en_original: Yeah. You helped me realize I don't need it.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. You helped me realize I don't need it.
records.en: Yeah.<CR>Thanks to Hiori-san, I realized I don't need it.

records.jp: この世界が消えても私たちの絆が消えるわけじゃない。<CR>……そうだよね、陽桜莉さん！
records.en_original: Even if this world disappears, our bond never will. Right, Hiori?
records.en_auxiliary: Even if this world disappears, our bond never will. Right, Hiori?
records.en: Even if this world disappears, our bond will not disappear.<CR>...Right, Hiori-san!

records.jp: うん！　新しい世界でも、また一緒に遊ぼうね。<CR>愛央ちゃん！
records.en_original: Yeah! Let's meet up and hang out in the new world, Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! Let's meet up and hang out in the new world, Ao!
records.en: Yeah! Let us play together again in the new world.<CR>Ao-chan!

records.jp: （……ありがとう、陽桜莉さん。陽桜莉さんのおかげで<CR>何が一番大切なのか分かったような気がする）
records.en_original: (Thank you, Hiori. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Thank you, Hiori. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en: (Thank you, Hiori-san. Thanks to Hiori-san,<CR>I feel like I understood what matters most.)

records.jp: （みんなとの思い出は、私の心に記録しよう。<CR>絶対に消えないように……刻み込むんだ！）
records.en_original: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en: (I will record my memories of everyone in my heart.<CR>I will engrave them there so they never disappear!)

records.jp: 美弦さーん！<CR>今から、インタビューするから答えてくんない？
records.en_original: Hey, Mio! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Mio! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en: Mio-san!<CR>I want to interview you now. Will you answer?

records.jp: インタビュー？　愛央らしく唐突ね。<CR>で、場所はここでいいの？
records.en_original: That's very sudden. Here?
records.en_auxiliary: That's very sudden. Here?
records.en: An interview? How suddenly like you, Ao.<CR>And is this place all right?

records.jp: うん。陽桜莉さんが美弦さんを見つけるきっかけに<CR>なった場所だから
records.en_original: Yeah. This place holds a lot of memories! It's how Hiori was able to find you.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. This place holds a lot of memories! It's how Hiori was able to find you.
records.en: Yeah. Because this is the place that became the reason<CR>Hiori-san was able to find you, Mio-san.

records.jp: ……ふふ。そうね
records.en_original: Hehe... That's right.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe... That's right.
records.en: ...Hehe. That is right.

records.jp: じゃ、行くよ！　質問でーす！
records.en_original: Here we go! First question!
records.en_auxiliary: Here we go! First question!
records.en: Okay, here we go! Question!

records.jp: この世界に来て<CR>一番、印象に残っていることはなんですか！
records.en_original: What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en: What is the thing that left the strongest impression on you<CR>since coming to this world?

records.jp: 印象に残っていること……そうね……
records.en_original: What I remember most... Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: What I remember most... Hmm...
records.en: What left the strongest impression... Let me see...

records.jp: 陽桜莉と再会できた時、あの子のことしか<CR>覚えていなかったことかしら
records.en_original: Probably the fact that when Hiori and I were reuinted, she was the only person I remembered.
records.en_auxiliary: Probably the fact that when Hiori and I were reuinted, she was the only person I remembered.
records.en: Perhaps that when I reunited with Hiori,<CR>she was the only person I remembered.

records.jp: そして……もう一つは、あなたのこと
records.en_original: And also... You.
records.en_auxiliary: And also... You.
records.en: And... one more thing is you.

records.jp: へ？　私？
records.en_original: Huh? Me?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Me?
records.en: Huh? Me?

records.jp: 清々しいくらい何も考えずに突進するかと思えば、<CR>みんなのことは誰よりも考えていて……
records.en_original: You rush into things without thinking at all, yet you also think so much about all of us..
records.en_auxiliary: You rush into things without thinking at all, yet you also think so much about all of us..
records.en: Sometimes you charge ahead without thinking to an almost refreshing degree,<CR>yet you think about everyone more than anyone...

records.jp: あなたを見ていて、飽きることはなかったわ。<CR>……眩しかった
records.en_original: You were never a bore to watch. You were...dazzling.
records.en_auxiliary: You were never a bore to watch. You were...dazzling.
records.en: I was never bored watching you.<CR>...You were dazzling.

records.jp: ま、眩しいとか、照れるんですけど……。<CR>え、えっとそれじゃあ、次の質問……
records.en_original: Y-you're making me blush... U-um, so the next question is...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you're making me blush... U-um, so the next question is...
records.en: D-dazzling is embarrassing...<CR>U-um, then, the next question...

records.jp: 待って、愛央。<CR>どうして急にインタビューなんか始めたの？
records.en_original: Hang on, Ao. Why did you start doing this interview out of nowhere?
records.en_auxiliary: Hang on, Ao. Why did you start doing this interview out of nowhere?
records.en: Wait, Ao.<CR>Why did you suddenly begin an interview?

records.jp: いつもの突発的な思い付き<CR>……じゃ、なさそうね
records.en_original: It doesn't seem like one of your usual antics.
records.en_auxiliary: It doesn't seem like one of your usual antics.
records.en: It does not seem to be<CR>one of your usual sudden ideas.

records.jp: （……あれ？　どうしてなんだろう？<CR>答えが出てこない……）
records.en_original: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why did I?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why did I?)
records.en: (...Huh? Why is that?<CR>I cannot find an answer...)

records.jp: 元の世界へ戻ったら、この日々も私たちのことも、<CR>全て忘れて、すれ違っても分からないかもしれない
records.en_original: I think you're afraid of forgetting about us and our time here when we return to our world.
records.en_auxiliary: I think you're afraid of forgetting about us and our time here when we return to our world.
records.en: When you return to the original world, you may forget these days and us,<CR>and fail to recognize us even if you pass by one another.

records.jp: それが不安で、せめて動画に残したくなった。<CR>……違う？
records.en_original: And that fear made you feel the need to try to create some type of record. Am I wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: And that fear made you feel the need to try to create some type of record. Am I wrong?
records.en: That made you anxious, so you at least wanted to preserve a video.<CR>...Am I wrong?

records.jp: 私……そっか。不安、だったんだ……。<CR>気持ちの整理はできてると思ってたのになぁ
records.en_original: Scared...? Yeah...I was. And here I thought I had my feelings in order.
records.en_auxiliary: Scared...? Yeah...I was. And here I thought I had my feelings in order.
records.en: I... I see. I was anxious...<CR>Even though I thought I had sorted out my feelings.

records.jp: 大丈夫。誰もが同じ不安を抱えていると思う。<CR>でも……こんな風にも思うの
records.en_original: It's okay. I think we're all worried about the same thing. But think of it this way...
records.en_auxiliary: It's okay. I think we're all worried about the same thing. But think of it this way...
records.en: It is all right. I think everyone holds the same anxiety.<CR>But... I also think of it this way.

records.jp: 私たちの日々は、間違いなく輝いていた。<CR>心の繋がりを、大切に深めてきた
records.en_original: Our time together shone more brightly than anything else. We tied deep bonds with one another.
records.en_auxiliary: Our time together shone more brightly than anything else. We tied deep bonds with one another.
records.en: Our days unquestionably shone.<CR>We carefully deepened the connections between our hearts.

records.jp: だから……あなた風に言うなら、何とかなる。<CR>私たちの絆は、世界の法則だって乗り越えられる
records.en_original: So, as you would say, it'll work out. These bonds will certainly transcend the laws of the world.
records.en_auxiliary: So, as you would say, it'll work out. These bonds will certainly transcend the laws of the world.
records.en: So... to put it in your words, it will work out.<CR>Our bonds can overcome even the laws of the world.

records.jp: 初めてここに来た時も、陽桜莉のことだけは<CR>覚えていたのだもの。きっと、忘れないわ
records.en_original: I still remembered Hiori when I first came to this world. I'm sure I will remember you as well.
records.en_auxiliary: I still remembered Hiori when I first came to this world. I'm sure I will remember you as well.
records.en: Even when I first came here, Hiori was the one person<CR>I remembered. I am sure I will not forget.

records.jp: ……うん！　そうだよ。<CR>こんなの、私らしくないよね！
records.en_original: Yeah... You're right! It's not like me to worry!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... You're right! It's not like me to worry!
records.en: ...Yeah! That is right.<CR>This is not like me!

records.jp: きっと何とかなる！　大事な人たちのこと、<CR>絶対に忘れたりしないし、絆はなくならない！
records.en_original: It'll work out! I won't forget about the people I love, and our bonds will never disappear!
records.en_auxiliary: It'll work out! I won't forget about the people I love, and our bonds will never disappear!
records.en: It will surely work out! I will absolutely never forget<CR>the people precious to me, and our bonds will not disappear!

records.jp: ええ。もし忘れていても、必ず思い出せる。<CR>そしてね……
records.en_original: That's right. And even if we do forget, our memories will come back to us.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. And even if we do forget, our memories will come back to us.
records.en: Yes. Even if we forget, we will definitely remember.<CR>And...

records.jp: あなたと陽桜莉が赤点を取らないように、<CR>まとめて面倒を見てあげる
records.en_original: I promise I won't ever let you or Hiori fail. I'll always keep an eye on you two.
records.en_auxiliary: I promise I won't ever let you or Hiori fail. I'll always keep an eye on you two.
records.en: I will look after both of you<CR>so that you and Hiori do not receive failing grades.

records.jp: （……ありがとう、美弦さん。美弦さんのおかげで<CR>何が一番大切なのか分かったような気がする）
records.en_original: (Thank you, Mio. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Thank you, Mio. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en: (Thank you, Mio-san. Thanks to Mio-san,<CR>I feel like I understood what matters most.)

records.jp: （みんなとの思い出は、私の心に記録しよう。<CR>絶対に消えないように……刻み込むんだ！）
records.en_original: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en: (I will record my memories of everyone in my heart.<CR>I will engrave them there so they never disappear!)

records.jp: 詩さん。<CR>今から、インタビューするから答えてくんない？
records.en_original: Hey, Uta! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Uta! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en: Uta-san.<CR>I want to interview you now. Will you answer?

records.jp: インタビューを……私に、ですか？
records.en_original: Questions? For me?
records.en_auxiliary: Questions? For me?
records.en: An interview... with me?

records.jp: うん！　この世界に来て<CR>一番、印象に残っていることはなんですか？
records.en_original: Yeah! What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en: Yeah! What is the thing that left the strongest impression on you<CR>since coming to this world?

records.jp: そうですね……<CR>陽桜莉さんや美弦さんと親しくなれたこと、です
records.en_original: Hmm... Perhaps becoming close friends with Hiori and Mio.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Perhaps becoming close friends with Hiori and Mio.
records.en: Let me see...<CR>Becoming close with Hiori-san and Mio-san.

records.jp: そっか……<CR>ふたりとは、元の世界でいろいろあったんだっけ
records.en_original: I see... You three had been through a lot before you came to this world, right?
records.en_auxiliary: I see... You three had been through a lot before you came to this world, right?
records.en: I see...<CR>You three had been through a lot before you came to this world, right?

records.jp: はい。<CR>でも……きっかけを作ってくれたのは……
records.en_original: Yes. But the person that brought us togther...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. But the person that brought us togther...
records.en: Yes.<CR>But the person who created the opportunity was...

records.jp: ……星崎さん。<CR>あなたの手は、いつも暖かいですね
records.en_original: Was you, Ao. Your hands are always so warm.
records.en_auxiliary: Was you, Ao. Your hands are always so warm.
records.en: ...Hoshizaki-san.<CR>Your hand is always warm.

records.jp: ……詩さん？
records.en_original: Uta...?
records.en_auxiliary: Uta...?
records.en: ...Uta-san?

records.jp: すみません。<CR>星崎さんが、とても心細そうに見えたものですから
records.en_original: I'm sorry. You seemed like you were in need of some comforting.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry. You seemed like you were in need of some comforting.
records.en: I am sorry.<CR>You looked very lonely, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 私は……元の世界へ戻るのが怖いです。<CR>その資格が私にあるとも思えません……
records.en_original: I...I'm afraid of returning to our world. I don't think I even deserve to.
records.en_auxiliary: I...I'm afraid of returning to our world. I don't think I even deserve to.
records.en: I... am afraid to return to our original world.<CR>I do not believe I have the right to do so either...

records.jp: 私が過去の私に呑まれずにいられたのは、<CR>みなさんが……星崎さんが傍にいてくれたからです
records.en_original: The only reason I was able to resist being taken over by my past self was because everybody stood by me. Especially you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: The only reason I was able to resist being taken over by my past self was because everybody stood by me. Especially you, Ao.
records.en: I was able to resist being swallowed by my past self<CR>because everyone... because Hoshizaki-san stayed beside me.

records.jp: 元の世界で全てを忘れてしまったら、<CR>私はもしかしたらまた、昔のように――
records.en_original: If I forget everything in returning to our world, I worry that I will end up—
records.en_auxiliary: If I forget everything in returning to our world, I worry that I will end up—
records.en: If I forget everything in the original world,<CR>perhaps I will once again become like I was before—

records.jp: ならないよ、詩さん
records.en_original: You won't, Uta.
records.en_auxiliary: You won't, Uta.
records.en: You won't, Uta-san.

records.jp: もし全部忘れちゃっても、みんなと離れ離れに<CR>なっても、ここでの詩さんは、詩さんの中にいるよ
records.en_original: Even if you forget everything, even if we are torn far apart, the Uta I know will always be within you.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if you forget everything, even if we are torn far apart, the Uta I know will always be within you.
records.en: Even if you forget everything and are separated from everyone,<CR>the Uta-san from here will remain inside you.

records.jp: 私の中に……？
records.en_original: Within me...?
records.en_auxiliary: Within me...?
records.en: Inside me...?

records.jp: うん。だから大丈夫。みんなのことだって、<CR>忘れちゃっても、会えばきっと思い出せる
records.en_original: Yeah. So, don't worry. Even if you forget everyone, I'm sure it'll come back to you.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. So, don't worry. Even if you forget everyone, I'm sure it'll come back to you.
records.en: Yeah. So it will be all right. Even if you forget everyone,<CR>when you meet them, you will surely remember.

records.jp: （そっか……私、不安だったんだ。<CR>詩さんの話で、気が付いた。私も同じなんだって）
records.en_original: (I get it now... I've been afraid too. Talking to Uta helped me realize that.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I get it now... I've been afraid too. Talking to Uta helped me realize that.)
records.en: (I see... I was anxious.<CR>Uta-san's story made me realize that I felt the same way.)

records.jp: 星崎さんの手……やっぱり暖かいです。<CR>この暖かさも、私の中に必ず残ると思います
records.en_original: Your hands... They're so warm, Ao. I know this warmth will remain with me.
records.en_auxiliary: Your hands... They're so warm, Ao. I know this warmth will remain with me.
records.en: Your hand... is warm after all, Hoshizaki-san.<CR>I think this warmth will definitely remain inside me too.

records.jp: ですから……<CR>元の世界でも、こうして手を繋いでくれますか？
records.en_original: So, will you hold my hand again in our world too?
records.en_auxiliary: So, will you hold my hand again in our world too?
records.en: So...<CR>will you hold my hand like this in our original world too?

records.jp: もちろんだよ。<CR>また手を繋いで、一緒にひまわりを見よう
records.en_original: Of course I will. Let's hold hands and go see some sunflowers.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course I will. Let's hold hands and go see some sunflowers.
records.en: Of course.<CR>We will hold hands again and look at sunflowers together.

records.jp: あの、動画……消してしまったんですか？
records.en_original: The video you took... Did you just delete it?
records.en_auxiliary: The video you took... Did you just delete it?
records.en: Um, the video... Did you delete it?

records.jp: うん。だって、こんなの必要ないって<CR>詩さんが気づかせてくれたから
records.en_original: I did. You helped me see that I don't need it, Uta.
records.en_auxiliary: I did. You helped me see that I don't need it, Uta.
records.en: Yeah. Because Uta-san made me realize<CR>that I don't need something like this.

records.jp: ふふ……いつもの星崎さんの笑顔です
records.en_original: Hehe... There's the smile I know.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe... There's the smile I know.
records.en: Hehe... That's your usual smile, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: （……ありがとう、詩さん。詩さんのおかげで<CR>何が一番大切なのか分かったような気がする）
records.en_original: (Thank you, Uta. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Thank you, Uta. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en: (Thank you, Uta-san. Thanks to Uta-san,<CR>I feel like I understood what matters most.)

records.jp: （みんなとの思い出は、私の心に記録しよう。<CR>絶対に消えないように……刻み込むんだ！）
records.en_original: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en: (I will record my memories of everyone in my heart.<CR>I will engrave them there so they never disappear!)
